breakdown.description: The prompt treats the effective-length factor K as if it affected only the mode shape, even though K directly enters the Euler buckling load through the effective length K L.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly uses P_cr = π²EI/(KL)² with K properly entering the effective length in the denominator. It does not repeat the erroneous instruction from the incomplete prompt that K 'affects only the mode shape' or that the load should be evaluated from π²EI/L². This aligns with the ground truth formula.
